lastIdeas.title: 🧠 Neural Doom Matrix
lastIdeas.description: An interactive WebGL reality-fracture particle mesh on the canvas that reacts to mouse velocity and audio frequencies from the trailer.
lastIdeas.instruction: Create `js/doom-matrix.js` using Three.js or custom canvas shaders, initializing a glowing green quantum grid that distorts during countdown digit changes and integrates with `js/main.js`.

lastIdeas.title: 🔊 Multiversal Audio Sfx
lastIdeas.description: A synthesized Web Audio API soundscape that generates low-frequency cinematic drones and subtle mechanical UI ticks without heavy external assets.
lastIdeas.instruction: Implement `js/audio-engine.js` with procedural oscillators and gain nodes triggered on button hovers, countdown milestones, and chat messages, toggleable via an audio HUD button in `includes/header.php`.

lastIdeas.title: ⚡ Quantum Variant Radar
lastIdeas.description: A live global telemetry map showing visitor countdown activity nodes worldwide with simulated multiverse breach coordinates.
lastIdeas.instruction: Build `includes/radar.php` and `js/radar.js` displaying an SVG world map with pulse markers representing active countdown viewers fetched via Netlify functions.
